_comment: THE store listing — Google Play and the App Store read their words from here (scripts/play-listing.mjs pushes Play; scripts/store-meta.mjs writes ios/App/fastlane/metadata for deliver; scripts/store-shots.mjs prints the captions). Splash truth rule applies: only what ships TODAY, nothing that waits on a vendor or on the next build (no texts until a Twilio number is verified, no QuickBooks until the QBO app exists, no hour/mile service meters until they are wired, no lock-screen push on iPhone until APNs is set up). Run truth-check on any change. Limits are enforced by the scripts.

play.title: HammerTrack: Fleet & Tool GPS
play.shortDescription: Live GPS for trucks, machines, tools and crews on the clock — theft alerts.
fullDescription: Know where every truck, machine and tagged tool is — and your crew while they're on the clock.

HammerTrack is GPS tracking for field fleets: construction, landscaping, paving, excavation, tree service, utilities and every crew that runs trucks and machines. One live map for your vehicles, heavy equipment, crew phones and the small tools that ride along with them.
WHAT YOU GET
• One live map — trucks (OBD-II plug-in trackers), machines (bolt-on GPS units), crew phones on the clock and Bluetooth tool tags
• Theft and left-site alerts on your lock screen — know within minutes when a truck or machine moves after hours
• Sites and yards — draw a zone and see arrivals, departures and hours on every site
• Replay any day — every stop and every site, the trail colored by speed
• Tools ride with trucks — see which truck is carrying the laser level
• Engine readings in plain words — RPM, coolant, fuel, battery and the check-engine light, where the truck reports them
• Service schedules by date, with work orders that open themselves when a machine comes due
• Time clock with GPS-verified time cards, overtime split and a CSV for payroll
• DOT short-haul records for drivers who stay within 150 air-miles
• Job photos pinned to the map, daily logs and equipment checks
• Turn-by-turn directions to sites and saved places
• Add a tracker by scanning its barcode, or paste your whole fleet in from a spreadsheet
BUILT FOR A PHONE IN A TRUCK
• Bluetooth tag listening runs only while the app is open, eases off when nothing is near, rests on low battery — and has its own off switch
• Speed alerts use your own limit for each zone, and need two fast readings in a row inside it — never one stray fix at the fence line
• Bad signal is normal: clock-ins, daily logs and equipment checks wait on the phone and send themselves when you're back
Requires a HammerTrack company account; trucks and machines need HammerTrack trackers. Crew members join by invitation from their company.
Built by a working site-work company that runs the same trucks and machines.

apple._comment: iPhone today: no lock-screen push until APNs is set up (docs/APP-STORE-PLAYBOOK.md), no phone tag listening (iOS hides tag MACs and iBeacon frames from Bluetooth scans, so the phone-gateway can match nothing — trucks hear the tags), and a FIRST version takes no release notes. Revisit each line when those land.
